en: Ecclesiastes 9

p.src: 1  For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

ja: め、そのすべてを探った。義
まれるのか、人には分からない。すべては彼らの行く手にある。
en: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.
u.src: 1  For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

p.src: 2  All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

ja: れた者にも、いけにえをささげる者にも、ささげない者にも、同じ運命が臨む。善
も罪人も同じであり、誓う者も、誓いを恐れる者も
en: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
u.src: 2  All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

p.src: 3  This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

ja: われるすべてのことの
en: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
u.src: 3  This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

p.src: 4  For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

en: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
u.src: 4  For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

p.src: 5  For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

en: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.
u.src: 5  For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

p.src: 6  Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

ja: しみもねたみも、すでに滅び
われるどのようなことにも、
en: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.
u.src: 6  Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

p.src: 7  Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

ja: はすでにあなたの行いを
en: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
u.src: 7  Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

p.src: 8  Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

en: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
u.src: 8  Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

p.src: 9  Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

ja: とともに喜んで暮らしなさい。あなたの空しい
涯のすべての日々において、これが、あなたの人生と
から受ける取り分である。
en: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
u.src: 9  Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

p.src: 10  Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

ja: にできることは何でも、
いなさい。あなたが向かっているよみ には、働きも、
en: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
u.src: 10  Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

ja: 9:10 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 9:10 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 11  I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

ja: のものでもない。パンは知恵ある者のものではなく、富は悟りある者のものでもなく、
は熟練した者のものでもない。
と偶然がすべての者に
en: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
u.src: 11  I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

p.src: 12  For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

ja: がわなにかかるように、人間も
en: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
u.src: 12  For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

p.src: 13  I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

en: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
u.src: 13  I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

p.src: 14  There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

ja: しかいなかった。そこへ
en: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.
u.src: 14  There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

p.src: 15  Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

en: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
u.src: 15  Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

p.src: 16  Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

en: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
u.src: 16  Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

p.src: 17  The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

ja: 静かに聞かれる知恵ある者の言葉は、
en: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
u.src: 17  The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

p.src: 18  Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
u.src: 18  Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
